content: Yesu homackacni gboliyelu fangkewec
Sabat dameng motome, iwa Maria Magadalen, nga Maria Yakobosle nenggac ailu Salome, yenge hikelu Yesule kponggbong heloc hoineholecti hosocnoningte fuli baibong.
Fuli balu Sonda ubiyacte mac saeme molickelu dongesiwa hikeebongka wenac ofewec.
Aime yenge hikelu yengungtihac mingagec ailu yanguc miibong, “Madi henebe yefina posa yogo igockelu kpalundungkenoledaicte?”
Inguc milu donge hilalu nganibong posatowa yogobac biyac igockelu kpalundungkeicne domawec. Ailu posa yogo sugucnebenang.
Nganilu dongesiwa felu nganibong, madec monic ngakpiine dalicne kwalac-kwalac holewec, yedi folewapec ngiyeme nganilu kwatackelu medecebawec.

Inguc aibong yedi yanguc edocebawec, “Ngenge mi hangocngebana. Yesu Nasaret-hocni malicpongka weibong, ngenge ye nganinogale kwesigaing. Aimebac ye biyac gboliyelu fangkegac, yawa mi fagac. Lobong fawecka, mac fafaine yogo nganining.

Ngenge hikelu mic-tengtengfocine nga Pita yanguc edocebaning, ‘Ye molickengelelu Galili prowinswa hikegac. Aime ngenge iwa hikelu ye bafuwadaing, yogo yeuctihac biyachac edocngebawec, inguc fikegac.’ ”
Inguc edocebame yenge kwatackelu dengdengebame dongesiwacni walu hikeibong. Ailu yenge hangocebame ngic monic mi edocebaibong.
Maria Magadalen fikecnowec
[Yesu ye Sondawa fangkewec, dameng iwa molickelu Maria Magadalen fikecnowec. Ye esecne aleng 7 yelacni yebicebawec, ngigac yogo hocne fikecnowec.
Fikecnome Maria ye hikelu agofocine yeholec momoc gaibong, yenge kwele-sowac ngagelu hiyalu gaebongka yanguc edocebawec,
“Yesu biyac fangkelu gagac, na nganigabac.” Inguc mime yenge yele yowa mi ngagesingkeibong.
Mic-tengteng yaeckang fikeyetewec
Aime yogolec lobeina mic-tengteng yaeckang yeke mac monicka hikenogale hikeebocka, ye ngani-nganiine monic ailu fikeyetewec.
Fikeyeteme yeke hefaliye hikelu agofocnginec gocne edocebaiboc. Aime yenge yekele yowa mi ngagesingkeibong.
Bole baningte milu edocebawec

Aime mic-tengtengfocine 11 yenge nosing nolu ngiyeebongka, Yesu ye yengela fikewec. Aime ye gboliyelu fangkeme gocne yengi nganilu edocebaibong, yogo mi ngagesingkeibong. Aime kwelengineng fongkewecte ailu ngaba silicka yowa edocebawec.
Edocebalu yowa yanguc miwec,

content.text: “Ngenge himongsoc hikelu ngic-ngigac sasawa yenge Siduc Madicne edocebalu weduyeledaing.
“Aime monic ngagesingkelu misa lowadaictebac, Wapongti ye bikickacni bamoctome wasecne aidaicte. Nga monic ye mi ngagesingkedaicte, yebac mimoctodaicte.
Aime ngagesingkedaingte, yengela pasile maaine yanguc fikedaicte, yenge nale wacka aleng yebicebadaingte ailu yowa gbolicne midaingte.
Yenge hema moledi balu mi sowaledaingte. Ailu homacte marasing nodaingtewa, yogodi mi basowalecebadaicte. Ailu yenge ngic-ngigac huckolec yengela mole lobong, yenge madickedaingte.”

content: Honocmengka fewec
Sugucne Yesu ye yowa inguc milu edocebame motome, Wapongti bame honocmengka fewec. Aime yele mole-foleinapec ngiyelu gagac.

Aime mic-tengteng yenge neboc nga nebocka hikelu Siduc Madicne ngic-ngigac edocebalu weduyeleibong. Aime Sugucnedi yengeholec game yenge bole babong pasile maaine fikewec, yogodi yowaine basanangkewec.]

footnotes.text: Hibi esecne Mareko kwelengkewec, yogo nganilu iwacni kwelengkebong kwelengkebong ofewec, yengelacni gocne 16:9-20 iwa mi fagac. Ngic-ngigac yenge hibi kwelengkeicne yogo wosaelu nganibong Marekodi mi kwelengkewec mecne.
